newsitem.title: POLAND: Final bids for Polish paper firm Swiecie seen soon.
newsitem.headline: Final bids for Polish paper firm Swiecie seen soon.

text.p: Between 10 and 20 firms are bidding for a 75-percent stake in Polish paper maker Swiecie and will likely submit final bids in the next few weeks, a Treasury Ministry spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
"Between 10 and 20 entities made preliminary bids by October 28 and now they're getting acquainted with the firm's information memorandum," Barbara Hajduk told Reuters.
She said negotiations would follow with the firms that submitted final bids.

The treasury ministry plans to sell the 75 percent of Swiecie, whose full name is Zaklady Celulozy i Papieru w Swieciu Celuloza SA, in blocks of at least 10 percent, with 20 percent reserved for employees and five percent going to restitution claims.

Swiecie, which employs 3,250 and has more than a 25-percent market share, made a net profit of 110 million zlotys last year on sales of 1.1 billion zlotys, and expects to net 102 million zlotys this year.
The government has also said a flotation of Swiecie on the Warsaw bourse was possible following the sale to the strategic investor.
